title: WHAT IF YOU COULD PAUSE EVERYONE BUT YOU?

segments.line: slide a coaster under it. Safe.
Mo is falling down the stairs.
pull him back before he hits.
A car blows through a red light.
Freeze. Frozen an inch away. You step aside.
What if you could pause everyone but you? Sounds like
the ultimate superpower. One terrifying catch: if time stops, light stops.
Photons travel at 300000 kilometres a second. Frozen, none can enter your eyes. You're
blind in pitch black. And air
molecules freeze into solid glass walls. You can't even breathe. That's real. So if
you pause the world... who unfreezes you?
